question: Where is the nearest stadium located on the southeast side relative to Tunca RiverPark, Robinsonville, MS?
sql: SELECT pois.poi_name, pois.addr_state, pois.addr_city, pois.amenity, pois.leisure, pois.tourism FROM pois WHERE pois.leisure = 'stadium' AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ST_Centroid( (SELECT p.geometry FROM parks AS p WHERE p.park_name ILIKE '%Tunca RiverPark%' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT r.geometry FROM regions AS r WHERE r.region_name ILIKE '%Robinsonville%' LIMIT 1)::geography) LIMIT 1) ), ST_Centroid(pois.geometry) )) BETWEEN 112.5 AND 157.5 -- Southeast direction (112.5 to 157.5 degrees) ORDER BY ST_Distance( (SELECT p.geometry FROM parks AS p WHERE p.park_name ILIKE '%Tunca RiverPark%' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT r.geometry FROM regions AS r WHERE r.region_name ILIKE '%Robinsonville%' LIMIT 1)::geography) LIMIT 1)::geography, pois.geometry::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
